nws_alerts.description: Heavy snow possible. Total snow accumulations of 10 to 18 inches above 7000 feet.

discussion.key_messages: - A cold Pacific trough brings accumulating mountain snow to northern Utah Wednesday night through Friday, heaviest Thursday. - Snow levels fall to valley floors by Thursday night.
discussion.synopsis: A ridge holds today before a trough digs into the Great Basin midweek, bringing a cold front and widespread snow to northern Utah Thursday.
